name: Determinant Minimum Disguise
description: Replaces the explicit one-hot permutation matrix with a matrix where M_{i,j} = min(a_i, j). The determinant of this matrix is non-zero if and only if the rows are distinct. By the Pigeonhole Principle, since there are k elements bounded by k, avoiding duplicate rows forces the channels to be a permutation of 1..k. This requires models to deduce the identical-row property to recover the Exact Cover structure, defeating surface-level pattern matching.
